data.name: Basanti
data.gender_notes: Basanti is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Basanti is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'vasanti'. It refers to the golden color of spring, symbolizing new beginnings and the arrival of happiness. The name is often associated with the goddess of spring, Basanti Devi, who is known for her beauty, grace, and nurturing energy. The name Basanti carries the meaning “Golden, radiant, or yellow” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Basanti usually hope their child will grow to embody golden, radiant, or yellow and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This name is often used in literature, art, and folklore to evoke a feeling of joy, rejuvenation, and creativity.
